rv.q: The Glasgow Poisoner is a gritty and thrilling new Scottish musical with incredible talent that is not to be missed!

All this unfolds over an entertainingly irreverent hour of jauntily operatic songs – there is a particularly good number about the various Victorian uses of arsenic – and bickering, bantering dialogue.
The writing is thrilling and shamelessly poetic, the setting a visual feast and nightmare of glaring neon and swirling video effects.

cn.t: Critics praise this riotously clever 60-minute musical about the infamous Madeleine Smith case, with its unique framing device and energetic storytelling earning strong reviews for transforming a Victorian scandal into entertaining lunchtime theatre.
